verdict.rationale: Docs claim Postgres wire-protocol compatibility ('Use any Postgres-compatible tool, no DuckDB install needed') which implies some BI tools could connect without custom glue, and DuckDB SDKs exist for several languages, but there is no explicit mention of JDBC/ODBC drivers or named, documented BI-tool integrations (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, named/certified BI-tool integration guides, and any hands-on confirmation that dashboards connect without custom glue.
